\documentclass{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{backgrounds}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \node[draw, fill=white] (a) at (0,0) {A};
  \node[draw, fill=white] (b) at (2,1) {B};
  \draw[->] (a) -- (b);
  \begin{pgfonlayer}{background}
    \fill[yellow] (a.south west) rectangle (b.north east);
  \end{pgfonlayer}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
